caption_L1: Forecast volume of vegetable oil imported to the European Union (EU 27) from 2015 to 2029 (in 1,000 tonnes) is a bar diagram. The x-axis shows Volume in thousand tonnes along a linear scale of range 0 to 12,000. The y-axis measures Year.
caption_L2L3: In 2018 the volume of vegetable oil imported peaked at between 10,000 and 12,000. There has been a steady decline in the volume in the following years down to 8,000 in 2029.
